  - **P16** "Text Box.24" — Text Box
    - text: "Then, we take a random texture and turn it into a buffer: / each rgba quadruplet (one byte per component, so 4 byte for / a color) will map to a point when Model Display is in "Color" mode / (what you usually want for a point cloud). / Some math is needed when computing the exture size: / we have 3000 vertices so we want at least 3000 points: / it could be a 300x10 texture but the aspect will be very wide; / a 55*55 texture gives 3025 points and is closer to a square aspect ratio / for the purpose of rendering the shader."

    - out: Out
  - **P18** "Text Box.25" — Text Box
    - text: "Note that in general, compute shaders in ossia score will be more powerful / as well as easier to use. / But in certain cases this allows to easily have a quick and complete low-level / access on the particular buffers that constitute a GPU geometry. / It's also a good way to rapidly process binary mesh data that doesn't come / in a format that specifies its layout, as this supports strided, packed and planar / layouts, etc."
